researched_by: F104 IT Help Desk + F3 Research + F37 Strategy Research + Auger + Helm
scope: 15 dropship shops + newsletter + Wren landing page (UK-based)

auger_recommendation.ecommerce: Next.js + Stripe + Snipcart (DIY, no SaaS lock-in)
auger_recommendation.uk: .co.uk for trust; VAT register at £85k; Stripe Tax + GDPR banner

helm_recommendation.hosting: Kinsta managed WordPress (multiple sites under one price)
helm_recommendation.uk: .co.uk for UK trust + .com for broader appeal

wren_synthesis.verdict: Lean start using Cloudflare stack for first 60 days; revisit per-shop branding choices when revenue arrives
wren_synthesis.hosting: Cloudflare Pages (free tier handles all 15 static storefronts + the newsletter site)
wren_synthesis.ecommerce: Stripe Checkout (hosted) — no PCI work, no monthly fee, ~1.5% + 20p per UK transaction
wren_synthesis.order_webhook: Cloudflare Workers — forward Stripe event to supplier email or API
wren_synthesis.why: 15 shops × 10 SKUs each is small enough that managed e-commerce (Shopify ~£375-525/mo or WooCommerce stack) is overkill. Static + hosted checkout = same outcome at ~5% the cost. We already have graphics + engineering teams to build the static templates.

shopify_alternative_if_speed_wanted.note: 15 separate stores would be £375/mo on Basic plan. Cheaper is one Shopify account, 15 product collections, one branded site.
